title.zh: 解绑带宽包与云企业网实例

descriptions.zh: 确保目标带宽包实例下不存在跨地域带宽。您可以删除已设置的跨地域带宽，具体操作，请参见[SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit](~~65942~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, ensure that no cross-region bandwidth is configured for the bandwidth plan. To delete the cross-region bandwidth, see [SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit](~~65942~~).
